integrity: The proof reconstructs the projective-subspace model and the ordinary domination lower bound before deriving the total and paired values. Exhaustive computations over four small prime-field cases are included only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to full matrix algebras over finite fields.
No claim is made for matrix rings over general finite rings, arbitrary division rings, or products of simple Artinian rings.
The result concerns the left-ideal intersection graph only.
title: Total and paired domination in left-ideal intersection graphs of \(M_n(\mathbb F_q)\)
